note: Synthetic. Shows knowledge going out of date (idea D).

messages.author: Aino Arkkitehti
messages.text: Heads up team: the firmware 4.2 rollout to all transmission nodes installed 2019 or earlier finished last night. Release notes say it fixes the forwarding-state bug after optical module replacement.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: So no more disable/enable trick after SFP swaps?

messages.author: Aino Arkkitehti
messages.text: Correct, it shouldn't be needed anymore on those units. If you still see zero counters after a swap, it's something else.
